submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, index 5 (Pb0.63Sb0.37) had the highest EQE: 0.0139%. That is about 5x index 14 (Pb0.50Sb0.50, 0.00275%) and about 18x index 24 (Pb0.31Sb0.69, 0.00077%). EQE rose steadily toward the Pb-rich end. In XRD, the Pb-rich phase peak at Q≈2.04 is strongest at index 5 and is linked to the higher EQE.

rejected.reason: Near 1:1 pyrochlore-like composition, but its measured EQE was 5x lower than index 5.
Sb-rich composition with the lowest measured EQE.

rejected.hypothesis: More Pb-rich compositions (indices 0-4) could be better still
